title: Turbines, Inc. Launches eCommerce Platform to Enhance Customer Purchasing Experience
summary: SENECA, S.C., Dec. 29, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Turbines, Inc., a leading U.S. manufacturer of turbine flow meters for liquid and gas measurement applications, is pleased to announce the launch of its new eCommerce platform, enabling customers to place orders securely online using debit or credit cards.
